summary: SOPHiA GENETICS SA filed a Form 6-K reporting a marketed follow-on offering of 12,104,900 ordinary shares (including full exercise of the underwriters' option) at $4.75 per share, raising approximately $57.5 million in gross proceeds. The offering was conducted under an underwriting agreement with TD Securities (USA) LLC as representative of the underwriters. It closed on June 18, 2026, and was registered on Form F-3. This is a routine equity capital markets transaction by the issuer, not a special situation. No board recommendation or advisor is named; the filing includes customary legal opinions and incorporation by reference.
